in_sanskrit.name: इन्द्रजीत
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is conquered by Indra, the god of thunder, rain and lightning.

in_hindi.name: इन्द्रजीत
in_hindi.long_meaning: विजोशिल (Vijoshil) - The one who has conquered or defeated (Indra).

in_tamil.name: இந்திரஜீத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: இந்திரன் (Indran) விடுதலையாள்வேன் (Viduthalaiyal) - The one who has conquered Indra.

in_telugu.name: ఇంద్రజీత్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఇంద్రపోయేదు (Indrapoyedu) గొప్పోదేశిన (Goppodeshina) - The one who has conquered Indra.

in_marathi.name: Inderjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Inderjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Inderjeet is a combination of two words: Inder (God) and Jeet (Victory). The name symbolizes the power of God within an individual, and the belief that with the divine grace, one can overcome any obstacle and emerge victorious.

The name symbolizes the power of God within an individual, and the belief that with the divine grace, one can overcome any obstacle and emerge victorious.
